Module media.barney.contract.core
Package media.barney.contract

Annotation Interface Contract.InRange

Enclosing class:
Contract
@API(status=MAINTAINED) @Contract @Target({PARAMETER,METHOD,FIELD,ANNOTATION_TYPE}) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented public static @interface Contract.InRange
Requires a numeric value to fall within the configured range.

Supported values are primitive numeric values, numeric wrapper types, BigDecimal, and BigInteger. A null object value is ignored and therefore passes.

Both range endpoints are inclusive by default. Use minInclusive() and maxInclusive() to make either bound exclusive.
